name: rushdb
description: RushDB for agents: search, query and analyze your data with RushDB MCP tools and skills, with optional automatic context across sessions.

settings.name: RushDB API URL

settings.name: RushDB automatic context
settings.description: off (default), recall, or recall+persist. recall adds earlier sessions at session start; recall+persist also stores finished turns in your RushDB project.
